note: Phase 10A Section 14: 7 fresh-process repetitions, SmolLM2-135M, ctx=2048, Vulkan (gpu-layers=all), generation tok/s.
conclusion: No meaningful performance difference between q4 and q8 on this GPU/backend/model -- the -1.09% delta is well within both modes' own run-to-run stddev (~3.5-4.3 tok/s on a ~260 tok/s mean), i.e. noise, not a real regression. Q4's memory/VRAM advantages (Sections 6-8, 13) come with no measurable generation-throughput cost here.
